count.description: The total number of subscriptions that match, across all pages, not only the ones in `results`.

next.description: URL of the next page, on your Connect domain. Follow it with `POST`, the same verb as the first page; a `GET` returns `405`. `null` on the last page.

previous.description: URL of the previous page, on your Connect domain. Follow it with `POST`, the same verb as the first page; a `GET` returns `405`. `null` on the first page.

id.description: The subscription's unique identifier. Pass it as `subscription_id` to retrieve, cancel, or list the cycles of this subscription.

customer_id.description: Your own identifier for the customer, as sent in `customer_id` at checkout.

customer_email.description: The customer's email address, captured when the subscription was created.

frequency.description: How often the customer is charged. Enum: `monthly`, `yearly`.

recurring_amount.description: The amount charged on each billing cycle, as a decimal string in `currency`.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the recurring charge, for example `KWD`.

status.description:
The subscription's lifecycle state. One of `pending_setup` (created, first payment not completed yet), `trialing` (set up with a `0` first charge, waiting for its first billing date), `active` (billing normally), `past_due` (a billing cycle used up every retry), `canceled`, `expired` (the `end_date` passed), or `setup_failed` (the first payment never completed).

A `past_due` subscription is never canceled automatically. See [Subscription States](/developers/payments/autopay/#subscription-states).

next_billing_date.description: The date of the next scheduled charge, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. `null` when no charge is scheduled.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp of when the subscription was created. The list is ordered by this field, newest first.

items.description: A lighter view of a subscription, returned for each row of the subscription list. It carries enough to show a table and to decide which subscriptions to open; call Retrieve a subscription for the full object.
items.title: AutoPaySubscriptionListItem

results.description: The subscriptions on this page, newest first. An empty array when nothing matches.

items.description: One page of subscriptions. See [Paging through the list](/developers/payments/autopay/#paging-through-the-list) for how to walk the pages of this `POST` list.
items.title: AutoPayPaginatedSubscriptions
